dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - June 05, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Giants Slug Their Way to Victory in 18-3 Thrashing of Cubs**

The San Francisco Giants delivered an onslaught of offense, pounding out 18 runs and 22 hits in a dominating 18-3 win over the Chicago Cubs. Matt Chapman led the charge, going 2-for-3 with two home runs and a career-high 8 RBIs. Casey Schmitt also homered, his 15th of the season. On the mound, Robbie Ray earned the win, pitching 5 strong innings with 4 strikeouts and 0 earned runs.

**Tigers Come from Behind to Beat Mariners 7-3**

In a game that saw 10 hits and 2 home runs, the Detroit Tigers rallied to take a 7-3 lead over the Seattle Mariners. Kerry Carpenter homered for the Tigers, while Spencer Torkelson also contributed with a solo shot. Framber Valdez earned the win, pitching 5 innings with 5 strikeouts and 1 earned run.

**Phillies Comeback Falls Short in 8-6 Loss to White Sox**

The Philadelphia Phillies staged a late rally, but ultimately fell short in an 8-6 loss to the Chicago White Sox. Randal Grichuk homered twice for the Phillies, while Bryce Harper also contributed with a big hit. Jonathan Bowlan earned the win for the White Sox, while Jhoan Duran earned the save.

**Red Sox Edge Yankees 5-3 in Tight Contest**

The Boston Red Sox edged the New York Yankees 5-3 in a tightly contested game. Willson Contreras homered for the Red Sox, while Sonny Gray earned the win. Aroldis Chapman earned the save for the Yankees.

**Orioles Rout Blue Jays 13-3**

The Baltimore Orioles pounded out 14 hits and 3 home runs in a 13-3 thrashing of the Toronto Blue Jays. Adley Rutschman led the way, going 4-for-4 with a home run and 5 RBIs. Brandon Young earned the win for the Orioles.

**Rays Shut Out Marlins 6-0**

The Tampa Bay Rays dominated the Miami Marlins 6-0, behind a strong 7-inning performance from Drew Rasmussen. Cedric Mullins homered for the Rays, while Rasmussen struck out 9 Marlins batters.
